components.name: Base selector
components.description: Base selector — steps through a short list of base options one at a time (dough, size, ice, roast…) with prev/next arrows and an image of the option. Arrows=Off when only one option exists. Loading shows a skeleton while options load. Overlay sits on product photos (fill/on-media).

3.11 Base selector
Steps through a short list of base options one at a time — image, name and prev/next arrows. 16 variants · Style × State × Arrows × Direction.
Overview
Pick one base for a product (dough, size, roast, ice, crust) while the photo stays visible. 2–6 options; the list loops.
